project.name: osgi/foundation/host
project.description: The host-access seams: the cross-cutting contacts by which the OSGi world reads and writes the host it runs on (git facts, secrets, path topology, artifact sinks). Not a domain — a foundation concern shared by several domains, so it lives here beside world-gateway rather than in any one domain. host-port declares the neutral seams; host-edge provides the live @Components that touch the host (jgit, java.nio, ProcessBuilder). The former control-plane host code keeps its own inline access until the split rewires it to call these; birthing the services does not unwire it.
